name: QuickBooks Desktop trial balance (CSV export)
notes: Reports → Accountant & Taxes → Trial Balance, exported to CSV. Three title lines above the header; the account column has no heading and reads "1050 · Savings"; amounts carry thousands separators; a TOTAL line at the end (skipped). Receivables and payables are refused on purpose: they come from the open invoices and bills in the platform (Books → Settings → Bring in open items). Accounts the chart lacks are created from the Type column.
